answer: Signal-Delay Coordination Toll. Each agent action must carry a fresh proof-of-work nonce whose difficulty scales with the number of distinct agents acting on the same target within a window. Legitimate single agents pay near-zero; a sybil cluster converging on one target faces difficulty rising linearly with cluster size. A neutral ferrous relayer audits timing and rejects batches lacking spread. The wharf (shared submission queue) throttles burst admission, forcing attackers to stagger identities across epochs, costing them time proportional to N².
